theme: Light mode by default (optimal for dense data tables and inputs).

font_family.body: IBM Plex Sans (for excellent tabular figure rendering and readability)

accents.primary: bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white (For primary actions, e.g., Simpan Transaksi)
accents.danger: bg-red-50 text-red-700 border border-red-200 (For 'Belum Lunas' / Outstanding Debts)

layouts.spacing: Generous container padding (p-6 or p-8). Tight gap (gap-4 or gap-6) for high-density grids.
layouts.dashboard_grid: Bento Protocol (Mode B). Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Summary cards span 1 col, Charts span 2-3 cols.
layouts.cards: Cardless or flat cards with sharp 1px borders (border-slate-200). Max 8px border-radius (rounded-lg). DO NOT use blurry drop shadows. If shadow is needed, use shadow-sm.
layouts.tables: Full-width, crisp cell borders, dense padding (py-2 px-3) to fit maximum data. Sticky headers.

components_instructions.ui_library: Use Shadcn UI primitives but heavily customize their look to match the 'Swiss High-Contrast' theme (flat, crisp, minimal).
components_instructions.forms: Use Shadcn Input, Select, DatePicker. Align labels to the top or left. Ensure the 'Input Transaksi' form is highly optimized for fast keyboard data entry.
components_instructions.tables: Use Shadcn Table. Make sure to implement horizontal scrolling for 'Tabel Rekap' as it will have many columns (Tanggal, Customer, Produk, Varian, Harga, Qty, Total, Status).
components_instructions.charts: Use Recharts or Shadcn Charts. For 'Omset Trends', use an AreaChart with a subtle blue gradient. For 'Sisa Tagihan / Belum Lunas', use a BarChart (red hues).
components_instructions.notifications: Use Sonner for toast notifications (e.g., 'Transaksi Berhasil Disimpan').

visual_enhancers.borders: Expose the skeleton. Use border-r and border-b on grid items for a technical, crisp look.
visual_enhancers.micro_interactions: Buttons should have active:scale-[0.98] and hover color shifts. Table rows should have hover:bg-slate-50.

login_background.description: Deep blue abstract fluid artwork. Use this on the left side of a 50/50 split-screen Login page, covering the full height (h-screen, object-cover). Apply a subtle black/20 overlay so any white logo placed on it pops.

empty_state.description: Warehouse/Forklift scene. Use cautiously (with heavy opacity reduction, e.g., opacity-10) if an empty state illustration is needed for the dashboard.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets APCA / WCAG AA standards. Never put light gray text on a white background.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements MUST have focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-blue-500 focus-visible:ring-offset-1.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute. E.g., `data-testid='btn-submit-transaction'`, `data-testid='input-customer-name'`.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Break this by making the dashboard feel incredibly crisp, fast, and distinctly branded for an industrial/logistics context.
Do not use dark colors as gradients. Use solid fills.
Never center align the app container. Align text left for natural reading flow, especially in data tables and forms.
Never use generic AI emojis for icons. Use Phosphor Icons, Lucide React, or similar professional sets.
Never use purely transparent backgrounds on elements that float over content (like headers or dropdowns). Use solid white or backdrop-blur with a background color (bg-white/90).
Use 2-3x more spacing for container paddings (p-6, p-8) to give the dense data room to breathe.

For the 'Input Transaksi' page, create a seamless flow: Select Customer -> Select Product & Varian (1200/550/330/230/GALON) -> Auto-fill Harga based on tier (Grosir/SO/Retail) -> Input Qty -> Auto-calculate Total -> Select Lunas/Belum Lunas.
For the 'Belum Lunas' dashboard metric, prioritize visibility. Outstanding receivables (Sisa Tagihan) is a critical business metric for this user. Make it prominent (Red/Warning styling).
In Javascript/React files (.jsx or .js), ensure prop types or clear default values are used since this isn't TypeScript.
